summary: Tested Clinic Groups + Stock Requests feature end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass covering group creation (idempotent), branch creation with branding+services inheritance, head-admin switcher grant, stock request CRUD, fulfil→auto stock_transfers draft with linked_request_id/linked_transfer_id, mark-po→fulfill lifecycle, decline, cancel, role separation (403 branch fulfill, 409 branch create-branch), source validation (400 same clinic). Frontend: /settings/clinic-group renders group console with head card (Sound Clinic Chain, 22 HAs, 47 low-stock SKUs, 68 patients) + Mysore branch card, Add Branch modal opens correctly. /ha/requests renders with all 5 tabs (pending/awaiting_po/fulfilled/declined/all), New Request modal opens, fulfilled tab shows 3 requests each with 'Linked transfer TRF-...' links to /inventory/transfers. Clinic switcher shows both Bangalore + Mysore clinics.
critical_code_review_comments: stock_requests.get_request depends injection is called from other endpoints by passing user/db kwargs — works but a bit fragile; consider extracting internal helper `_get_request_row(db, request_id, ids)` to avoid re-dependency injection when called manually.

In list_requests, `_accessible_clinic_ids_for_requests` is computed but then only used for head; branch path just filters by user['clinic_id']. Minor optimization: skip the helper call for branch users.

Fulfil modal in StockRequestsPage.jsx: If head fulfils their own clinic's request (head-raised), sources exclude only requester — good — but head_clinic acts as source auto-selected; if head requests, source list will show branches only (correct). No issue found.
